subject: Request: early-arrival hotel exception & shared car booking for Acme workshop
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: early-arrival hotel exception & shared car booking for Acme workshop

Hi Samantha,

Quick one as we finalize logistics for next week's Acme enterprise workshop. We have three Redwood attendees arriving the evening before the event (7/19) and two arriving very early the morning of (7/20). The standard check-in is 3pm, but the execs need rooms available by 10:00am on 7/20 for prep.

Two asks for your team:
- Early check-in authorization for 3 rooms on 7/20 (rooms reserved under Acme meeting block). Please confirm the surcharge and whether Acme will absorb it or if we should charge Redwood.
- Shared car routing: instead of three separate taxis from SFO, can Acme coordinate one 7-seat shuttle for the executive party (5 pax) and one smaller ride for the others? That will simplify arrivals and reduce cost.

I've cc'd Monica (onsite logistics) and Neha (sales lead) so they can align billing and update the itinerary. If you can send the hotel quote and transport estimate, we'll route for approval today.

Thanks,
Michael Grant
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@acmehealth.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Travel <travel@acmehealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: early-arrival hotel exception & shared car booking for Acme workshop

Hi Michael,

We can accommodate early check-in for three rooms on 7/20. The hotel is offering a guaranteed 10:00am early check-in for a flat surcharge of $180 per room. Alternatively they can waive the fee if the cost is posted to the master account for the event (Acme sponsorship). Please advise which route you prefer.

For arrivals, Acme Travel recommends a 7-seat shuttle for the five executives and one shared sedan for the remaining attendees. Estimated total transport cost is $190 for the shuttle and $48 for the sedan (one-way). If Redwood prefers separate rides we can arrange that as well, but shuttle is more efficient.

I'm attaching a preliminary hotel quote and the shuttle estimate.

Best,
Samantha Ortiz
Event Manager, Acme Health

Attachment: Acme_Hotel_earlycheck_quote_20260711.pdf (pdf)
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@acmehealth.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 11:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: early-arrival hotel exception & shared car booking for Acme workshop

Laura,

Forwarding Samantha's note and attached hotel quote. Summary of proposed charges if Redwood covers the early check-in (worst case):
- Hotel early check-in surcharge: 3 rooms x $180 = $540
- Shuttle (one-way): $190
- Sedan (one-way): $48
Estimated one-way incremental cost: $778. We can round to $800 to include parking/tips. Return legs are included in the original transportation booking for most attendees.

Requesting approval to:
1) Approve up to $800 one-time logistics surcharge to be charged to the workshop budget (PRJ-WKSP-ACME).
2) Approve shuttle for executive party and single sedan for remaining attendees.

If you prefer Acme to post the early check-in surcharge to their master account, we can ask them to cover the $540 and Redwood would only cover the shuttle. Monica, please confirm coding to PRJ-WKSP-ACME if approved.

Michael,

Approve up to $800 total from PRJ-WKSP-ACME for the one-time logistics surcharge. Approve the 7-seat shuttle for the executive party. A couple of asks:
- Cap per-room early check-in exposure to $150 each; if hotel insists on $180, ask Acme to post to their master account and note the exception in the final invoice.
- Confirm that any gratuities or parking are either included in the shuttle estimate or will be logged to the same project code.

Please proceed and get a written confirmation from Acme on who will be charged for the hotel fee if they cannot reduce it.

Subject: Re: Final logistics: early check-in and transport confirmation for Acme workshop

Hi Samantha,

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Per Laura's approval, Redwood will cover up to $800 for the incremental logistics charge. Two actions from Acme:
1) Please confirm whether the hotel will accept the $150 per-room cap. If not, please post the $540 early check-in fee to Acme's master account and confirm in writing.
2) Proceed with the 7-seat shuttle and single sedan for arrivals on 7/20. Please send final invoices and a DocuSign amendment for signature so we can route to finance.

I've attached the updated itinerary for onsite ops. If you can send the DocuSign envelope link I will get it routed immediately.

Best,
Monica Patel
